purpose: Freeze information sufficiency, comparison baselines, event-level metrics, time-clustered diagnostics and deterministic development PASS/FAIL logic for AC_MA20_PULLBACK_RECLAIM_V1 before reading any real AC event outcomes.

fold1.role: consumed independent mechanism replication and later development

fold2.role: consumed setup-shape and transition research; allowed for development

event_construction_lock.P: immediately preceding joint SSE+SZSE A-share trading session; do not skip backward over a missing/suspended stock bar
event_construction_lock.same_security_episode_suppression: suppress new accepted event from D through its fixed D+10 joint-calendar target date inclusive

same_date_universe_baseline.definition: For each fold and signal date D, arithmetic mean exact-horizon return of all finite-return PIT-eligible, tradestatus=1 securities in that fold on D.
same_date_universe_baseline.reason: Provide a deterministic broad same-date benchmark aligned with prior development research.

intact_trend_non_reclaim_baseline.definition: On the same fold/date D, securities with finite/tradable P and D features such that close_vs_ma20(P) > 0.0, close_vs_ma50(P) > 0.0, close_vs_ma20(D) > 0.0 and close_vs_ma50(D) > 0.0; accepted reclaim events are excluded.
intact_trend_non_reclaim_baseline.purpose: Test whether a pullback-reclaim event adds timing information beyond simply occupying an intact above-MA20/above-MA50 trend state.
intact_trend_non_reclaim_baseline.dates_below_minimum_controls: excluded from incremental timing diagnostic only; they remain eligible for event-vs-universe analysis

per_event.D10_excess_universe: event D10 return minus same-date fold-universe D10 mean
per_event.D5_excess_universe: event D5 return minus same-date fold-universe D5 mean

per_signal_date.D10_reclaim_excess_mean: mean D10_excess_universe across valid accepted reclaim events on D
per_signal_date.D5_reclaim_excess_mean: mean D5_excess_universe across valid accepted reclaim events on D
per_signal_date.D10_incremental_timing_spread: mean accepted reclaim-event D10 return minus mean intact-trend-non-reclaim D10 return on dates with >=20 valid controls

fold_aggregate.primary: equal-weight mean across valid signal dates of D10_reclaim_excess_mean
fold_aggregate.secondary: equal-weight mean across valid signal dates of D5_reclaim_excess_mean
fold_aggregate.incremental: equal-weight mean across valid diagnostic dates of D10_incremental_timing_spread
fold_aggregate.quarter_primary: equal-weight mean D10_reclaim_excess_mean within each valid calendar quarter
fold_aggregate.leave_one_valid_quarter_out_primary: equal-weight mean D10_reclaim_excess_mean after excluding each valid quarter in turn

event_metrics.reason_for_date_weighting: Event incidence can cluster on broad market pullback/recovery dates; equal signal-date weighting prevents one synchronized date from dominating through event count.

bootstrap_diagnostic.procedure: Within each fold, resample valid signal dates with replacement; when a date is selected, retain all valid reclaim-event observations and recompute the date-weighted aggregate.
bootstrap_diagnostic.reason: Folds0-2 are consumed development evidence; untouched fold3 is reserved for later confirmatory inference.

development_PASS_requires_all: All minimum-information conditions pass independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Primary mean D+10 reclaim excess versus same-date universe is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
D+10 incremental timing spread versus intact-trend non-reclaim occupancy is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Positive valid-quarter primary D+10 share is >= 2/3 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Every leave-one-valid-quarter-out primary D+10 mean is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Secondary mean D+5 reclaim excess versus same-date universe is > 0 in at least two of the three folds.
No source, PIT, calendar, identity, event-suppression or implementation blocker exists.

terminal_logic.if_PASS: V2_8_10_AC_PULLBACK_RECLAIM_DEVELOPMENT_PASS; freeze exact implementation and a separate pre-fold3 confirmatory contract before any fold3 access.
terminal_logic.if_INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: V2_8_10_AC_PULLBACK_RECLAIM_DEVELOPMENT_INCONCLUSIVE; do not relax thresholds post-result and keep fold3/fold4 sealed.

implementation_validation_required_befor: Locked evaluator must bind this gate and V2.8.10 candidate id exactly.
Deterministic self-tests must verify P is the immediately previous joint trading session and never a skipped-back stock bar.
Self-tests must verify the P<=MA20/P>MA50 to D>MA20/D>MA50 transition exactly.
Self-tests must verify D+1-or-later data cannot affect D event construction.
Self-tests must verify same-security D through D+10 suppression.
Self-tests must verify intact-trend non-reclaim controls exclude accepted reclaim events.
Self-tests must verify equal signal-date weighting and clustered bootstrap determinism.
Self-tests must verify compression features and liquidity alpha are not used.
Self-tests must verify fold3/fold4 are absent from source configuration.
Evaluator hash and validation receipt must be frozen before real folds0-2 execution.
forbidden: No distance buffer around MA20 or MA50.
No trend percentile or weighted score.
No gap, bar-range, distance-from-high, market-state or evidence-freshness filter after seeing results.
No event-count threshold relaxation after seeing results.
No bootstrap-CI or p-value rule added after seeing development results.
No coefficient fitting or machine learning.
No fold3/fold4 price or outcome retrieval.
